measurement_limits: Timing includes checkpoint output; excludes import, CPU BVH build and GPU preparation. Concurrent unrelated workloads were present; these are observations, not backend speed rankings.
geometry_bvh_bytes and gpu_buffer_bytes are logical payload counts, not total process/driver memory peaks.
Blender uses viewport depsgraph with subdivision render levels; render-only modifiers/hair/compositor are not fully captured.
Legacy shader lobes, thin-glass alpha coverage, missing translucency/masks/normal maps and legacy light nodes are approximations, not Cycles equivalence.
Blender generates only source color/world bakes. All displayed beauty PNGs are rendered by SceneRenderer Metal PT.
Metal and Vulkan raw RGB arrays match for the two recorded comparison runs; this does not establish equivalence for all scenes.
